historical_growth.fcf_note: FY2023 adjusted FCF: $91.8M, FY2024 adjusted FCF: $181.3M, 9M FY2025: $204.2M
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity growth rates are not meaningful for Figma due to recent IPO (Oct 2024), convertible preferred stock conversions, massive SBC events (Q2 2024: $858M, Q3 2025: $1.14B), and IPO proceeds. Revenue CAGR is the most reliable growth indicator. FY2024 revenue grew 48% YoY, FY2025 guided ~40% YoY growth. FCF margins expanding rapidly from 18% (FY2023) to 24% (FY2024) to 27% (9M FY2025).

base.rationale: Revenue growth decelerates from ~40% toward mature SaaS levels as market penetration increases. FCF margins expand modestly as operational leverage improves and SBC normalizes post-IPO.

bull.rationale: AI-powered design tools drive significant market expansion. FigJam and Dev Mode reach maturity. Enterprise adoption accelerates. International expansion successful. FCF margins reach best-in-class SaaS levels (35-40%) as SBC normalizes.

bear.rationale: AI disruption from competitors (Adobe Firefly, Canva AI, Microsoft Designer) erodes market share. Economic slowdown impacts enterprise spending. Customer churn increases. Pricing pressure from AI-native competitors. SBC remains elevated to retain talent.

key_drivers: Revenue growth trajectory: FY2024 +48% YoY, FY2025 guided ~40%, decelerating to 15-25% long-term
FCF margin expansion: FY2023 18% → FY2024 24% → 9M FY2025 27% → terminal 27-40%
Zero debt, $1.58B net cash provides significant downside protection
Stock down 85% from IPO highs reflects AI disruption fears and competitive pressure
SBC normalization critical: Q2 2024 $858M and Q3 2025 $1.14B distort profitability
bull_case_catalysts: AI features (FigJam AI, Dev Mode AI) drive pricing power and reduce churn
Enterprise penetration accelerates (customers paying $100K+ grew from 963 to 1,262)
Developer ecosystem monetization via plugins and integrations
Potential acquisition of complementary design tools
bear_case_risks: AI-native competitors (v0.dev, Uizard, Galileo AI) capture next-gen designers
Adobe reintegrates Figma features into Creative Cloud post-failed acquisition
Canva's enterprise push with AI tools erodes SMB/mid-market share
Economic downturn reduces design team hiring and seat expansion
Free tier cannibalization as AI lowers barriers to design
Sustained elevated SBC (10-15% of revenue) limits FCF margin expansion
model_assumptions: Base case uses FY2024 adjusted FCF of $181.3M as starting point
Revenue growth based on 48% FY2024 actual, 40% FY2025 guidance, decelerating
WACC 10.5% reflects high-growth SaaS risk profile post-IPO
Terminal growth 3.0% assumes mature SaaS market dynamics
FCF margin expansion driven by operational leverage and SBC normalization
